q: What is the carbon footprint of our stall at a trade exhibition?
title: Exhibition stall carbon footprint
short: For an exhibitor, the big items are usually team travel and hotel nights, then building the stall and shipping samples. Stall electricity is often small. Reusing a modular stall instead of a one-time build is the easiest cut.

ul: Flights, trains and hotel nights for staff.
Stall build: plywood, vinyl prints, carpets.
Freight for samples and stall material.
Power drawn at the stall, if the organiser reports it.

p: Travel is Category 6 and stall materials are Category 1. The organiser's venue energy is theirs to report.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
